caption:
An abandoned cart is a question to investigate. 🛒

When someone adds a product and leaves, the first reaction is often a discount. But the real reason may be something else: extra costs that appear late, unclear delivery time, a page that does not feel trustworthy, or a payment step that does not work smoothly.

Go through your own checkout on your phone, note every surprise, fix the cause, and only then consider a discount. If customers agreed to hear from you, a short polite message can also teach you a lot.
